id.description: Stable identity, generated once and never reused. Nothing in the catalog references a collection by path.

date.description: First release date, or first item release date, at whatever precision the source supports: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Don't pad in fabricated precision.

ongoing.description: Whether new items are still being produced for the collection.

description.description: Prose context. Original synthesis only, never pasted or lightly reworded source text.

image.description: URL of the collection's own logo

tags.description: Ids referencing tag entities under tags/, for cross-cutting groupings (e.g. franchise) that directory position doesn't already express.
